moments.title: European Athletics Championships begin
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships kick off today in Birmingham, bringing a week of top-tier track and field action to the UK.

angles.name: Live from Birmingham
angles.copy: Ready, set, GO! The European Athletics Championships are officially underway in Birmingham. Who are you backing for gold this week?

angles.name: First finals tonight
angles.copy: Day one of the European Athletics Championships culminates tonight with several finals, including the men's and women's shot put. Catch the action live!

moments.title: House of the Dragon S3 Finale
moments.blurb: Season three of the Game of Thrones prequel, House of the Dragon, reaches its dramatic conclusion tonight with episode 8 on Sky Atlantic.

angles.name: Dragonfire finale
angles.copy: It's all been leading to this! The third season of House of the Dragon wraps up tonight. Are you ready for the ultimate Targaryen showdown?

angles.name: What's next for Westeros?
angles.copy: After tonight's House of the Dragon finale, the big question is: what's next for the Seven Kingdoms? No spoilers, but the chatter is already huge!

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament culminates this Sunday, August 16th, with Finals Day at Lord's, where the men's and women's champions will be crowned.

angles.name: Cricket Final Countdown
angles.copy: Just days to go until The Hundred Finals Day at Lord's! Who will lift the trophy this Sunday? Get ready for explosive cricket action.

angles.name: Lord's Hosts Grand Finale
angles.copy: The Home of Cricket, Lord's, prepares to host The Hundred Finals Day this Sunday. It's set to be a spectacular end to the season!

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival in full swing
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, is in full swing until August 31st, transforming Scotland's capital with thousands of performances.

angles.name: Fringe Fever
angles.copy: Edinburgh is alive with Fringe fever! Thousands of shows, from comedy to cabaret, are taking over the city. What's on your must-see list?

angles.name: Arts Takeover
angles.copy: The Edinburgh Fringe Festival is in full flow, showcasing incredible talent from around the globe. Dive into the world's biggest arts festival!

moments.title: Boomtown Festival kicks off
moments.blurb: The immersive Boomtown Festival begins this Wednesday, August 12th, offering a unique experience with diverse music genres and themed districts until August 16th.

angles.name: Boomtown is back!
angles.copy: Get ready for Chapter 4: The Twin Trail! Boomtown Festival opens its gates on Wednesday for five days of music, art, and immersive storytelling.

angles.name: Explore the districts
angles.copy: From hidden venues to pumping main stages, Boomtown is all about exploration. Which district are you hitting first this week?

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The Official Singles Chart Update for August 9-15, 2026, is out, showing the UK's biggest songs based on streams, downloads, and sales.

angles.name: Midweek Chart Buzz
angles.copy: The Official Singles Chart Update is in! Who's climbing, who's falling, and who's poised to take the top spot this week?

angles.name: New Music Movers
angles.copy: Always love to see the midweek chart predictions! Any surprise movers or new entries catching your ear in the Official Singles Chart Update?

moments.title: Kettama's 'Comes and Goes' on UK Chart
moments.blurb: Irish producer Kettama's track 'Comes and Goes' has reached number 77 on the UK Singles Chart, praised as an 'euphoric, rave-ready romp'.

angles.name: Dance Chart Climber
angles.copy: Huge news for Kettama! His track 'Comes and Goes' is making waves on the Official Singles Chart. Get this euphoric banger on your playlist!

angles.name: Rave-Ready Hit
angles.copy: If you need a new track to get you moving, Kettama's 'Comes and Goes' is climbing the charts and bringing serious rave vibes. Tune in!

moments.title: Happy 79th Ian Anderson
moments.blurb: Ian Anderson, the iconic frontman and flautist of Jethro Tull, turns 79 today.

angles.name: Flute & Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 79th birthday to the one and only Ian Anderson of Jethro Tull! Still rocking that flute like no other. What's your favourite Tull track?

angles.name: Progressive Rock Pioneer
angles.copy: Celebrating Ian Anderson's 79th birthday today! The distinctive sound of Jethro Tull wouldn't be the same without his incredible talent.

moments.title: Happy 62nd Neneh Cherry
moments.blurb: Swedish singer-songwriter Neneh Cherry, known for her genre-blending hits, celebrates her 62nd birthday today.

angles.name: Buffalo Stance Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 62nd birthday to the iconic Neneh Cherry! From 'Buffalo Stance' to '7 Seconds', her influence on music is undeniable.

angles.name: Genre-Bending Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 62nd birthday to the always cool Neneh Cherry! An artist who consistently pushed boundaries and delivered timeless tunes.

moments.title: Happy 72nd Joe Jackson
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter Joe Jackson, celebrated for hits like 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?', turns 72 tomorrow.

angles.name: New Wave Birthday
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we're wishing a very happy 72nd birthday to the brilliant Joe Jackson! What's your favourite track from this New Wave legend?

angles.name: Still Going Out With Him?
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate Joe Jackson's 72nd birthday tomorrow! His sharp songwriting and distinctive sound are truly timeless.

moments.title: Happy 77th Mark Knopfler
moments.blurb: Mark Knopfler, the legendary guitarist and frontman of Dire Straits, will celebrate his 77th birthday on Wednesday.

angles.name: Money For Nothing Birthday
angles.copy: Rock legend alert! Mark Knopfler of Dire Straits turns 77 on Wednesday. His guitar riffs are truly iconic. What's your go-to Dire Straits song?

angles.name: Sultans of Swing
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate Mark Knopfler's 77th birthday this Wednesday! The Dire Straits frontman's influence on music is immense.

moments.title: Happy 68th Madonna
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, will celebrate her 68th birthday this Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: Queen of Pop's Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to strike a pose! This Sunday, the incomparable Madonna celebrates her 68th birthday. What's your all-time favourite Madonna anthem?

angles.name: Iconic Influence
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to Madonna this Sunday! Her impact on music, fashion, and culture is simply legendary.

moments.title: Happy 68th Belinda Carlisle
moments.blurb: Belinda Carlisle, the lead vocalist of The Go-Go's and a successful solo artist, turns 68 on Monday, August 17th.

angles.name: Heaven Is A Place On Earth
angles.copy: Next Monday, we're wishing a very happy 68th birthday to the incredible Belinda Carlisle! What's your favourite Go-Go's or solo hit?

angles.name: Pop-Rock Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Belinda Carlisle's 68th birthday next Monday! From punk beginnings to pop superstardom, her career is truly inspiring.

moments.title: Happy 57th Kelvin Mercer (Posdnuos)
moments.blurb: Kelvin Mercer, also known as Posdnuos from the legendary hip-hop group De La Soul, celebrates his 57th birthday on Monday, August 17th.

angles.name: De La Soul Legend
angles.copy: D.A.I.S.Y. Age forever! Wishing a very happy 57th birthday to Kelvin Mercer (Posdnuos) of De La Soul next Monday. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Hip-Hop Pioneer
angles.copy: Next Monday, we celebrate the birthday of Kelvin Mercer, an absolute pioneer in hip-hop with De La Soul. Their influence is still massive!

moments.title: Edinburgh International Book Festival begins
moments.blurb: The Edinburgh International Book Festival begins this Friday, August 15th, offering over 800 events with authors, workshops, and debates until August 30th.

angles.name: Page-Turner Festival
angles.copy: Bookworms rejoice! The Edinburgh International Book Festival kicks off this Friday. Dive into a world of literature with hundreds of events.

angles.name: Meet Your Favourite Authors
angles.copy: Starting Friday, the Edinburgh International Book Festival is your chance to meet authors, join debates, and discover new stories. Who are you hoping to see?

moments.title: Vegan Camp Out Festival
moments.blurb: The Vegan Camp Out, the world's largest vegan festival, takes place from August 14th to 17th, featuring music, food, and activism.

angles.name: Vegan Vibes
angles.copy: The world's largest Vegan Camp Out kicks off this Thursday! Get ready for a weekend of plant-based food, music, and community.

angles.name: Festival for a Cause
angles.copy: More than just music! Vegan Camp Out, starting Thursday, combines festival fun with a focus on ethical living and activism. Who's heading there?
